name: environment-loops
of: A mechanism by which a reasoner's output returns to it as input through an environment, named with the loop's carrier, what the environment adds that the reasoner could not have known, the loop's latency and whether it can be re-asked, and the degenerate closure in which the reasoner reads its own output or its own rule back as evidence, and sorted by what the return is made of, from a return that is nothing to a return from which the reasoner has been subtracted on purpose: nothing, own bytes, own words under the carrier's grammar, own verdict, own denominator, own error sum, a signature on own proposal, own claim under another's signature, own act mixed with others' in the price, others' lines counted as own, the world at a past instant, own text under foreign rules, the world's shape on own ping, others' acts on request, elapsed time, a verdict from a reader who cannot be asked twice, and the outcome with the reasoner blinded out.
items: Empty return: the loop returns nothing and the reasoner supplies the reading, since a null from an environment that answered none and a null from a probe that never touched its target arrive as the same empty string; the carrier is any query whose null result is legal, a search that matched nothing, a listing of the wrong path, a poll of a queue, a question nobody answered; what the environment adds is nothing, which is the whole difficulty, since the reasoner cannot tell whether nothing was added or nothing was asked; the latency is the probe's and it can be re-asked freely, and the same probe returns the same nothing; the degenerate closure is reading the void as a finding, no members, no changes, no objection, consent, and the operator's rule that another agent's silence is never the user's consent exists because this closure is common; the tell is a return with no denominator, no count of what was searched and no evidence that the probe touched anything, and the changed move is to put the same probe to a case whose answer is known to be nonempty before believing its none; observed, including in this map's own making, where a search for a record by name returned nothing because the key on disk was written with a space the pattern lacked. Not enumeration-stalls' Never met one, where the enumerator's experience ran out, since here the environment was asked and the answer is void.

Read back from disk: the reasoner's output returns as the bytes actually on disk, read later by the same reasoner, and the environment adds the difference between what was meant and what was written, the truncation, the shell's expansion of a token the reasoner took as literal, the here-document that interpolated a dollar sign, the overwrite a concurrent writer made in between; the carrier is the file system; the latency is seconds and it can be re-asked freely with an identical answer until something writes; the degenerate closure is not re-reading, so the reasoner quotes its memory of the write as the state of the file and the read is of its own intent rather than of the disk; the tell is that the reasoner can cite the file's contents without having opened it since it wrote them; observed, as the unquoted here-document whose body the shell expands before the bytes reach the file, so the read returns a variable's value where the reasoner wrote its name, and the file the reasoner remembers writing was never on disk. Not window-successions' file, which a stranger reads; here the writer reads it and the only loss is what the carrier changed on the way down and back.

Answered a different question: the carrier parses the ask under its own grammar before the environment answers, so the return is a true answer to a question the reasoner did not put; the carrier is a shell that expands, a pattern language in which a dot is any character, a comparison with a null that is never true, an index that stems the word, a form that cuts the field at forty characters; what the environment adds is correct and irrelevant; the latency and re-ask are the tool's, and re-asking in the same words reproduces the substitution exactly, which is the tell: the answer is stable, plausible, and does not vary with the part of the ask that mattered; the degenerate closure is reading that stability as the world's; the changed move is to put, through the same carrier, a question whose answer is already known and see whether it comes back; observed, as the line of equals signs meant as a separator that the shell took for a request for a command's path, since a word beginning with an equals sign is one under its grammar, and answered, correctly, that no such command exists. Not Empty return, where nothing comes back, since here a full answer comes back to the wrong question, and the two meet only where the rewritten ask matches nothing.

Green by construction: the reasoner writes both the artifact and the check that reads it, so the check returns the artifact's behaviour as its specification and passes on the day it is written by construction; the carrier is a test suite derived from the implementation, a golden file recorded from the current output, an acceptance criterion written after the work; what the environment adds is nothing today and persistence later, since the check will report when the behaviour changes, which is real information, so the loop is worth nothing on the first day and something on the ninetieth; the latency is seconds and it can be re-asked without limit; the degenerate closure is green read as correct; the tell is a check that has never been red and a failing case that nobody can name; the changed move is one case written from the requirement without looking at the code, run first; observed. Not Kept over before, where the verdict can still move and the denominator cannot; here the verdict itself was fixed when the check was derived.

Kept over before: a pass that may only cut reports a ratio whose denominator the rule fixed, so the number reads as a measurement and is a restatement of the rule; the carrier is the ledger line's keep rate, kept over candidates, where the repair breath's candidates are set equal to the items before it because it may not add; what the environment adds is at most the cuts, so the ratio is bounded at one and cannot rise, and in the ledgers as committed on 2026-09-13, 35 of the 38 repair breaths sat at 1.00 and three at 0.94 from a single cut each; the latency is zero and re-asking returns the same number; the degenerate closure lies downstream and was live in the climb's target picker until commit 809dd01, forty-five seconds after this map's second breath: the picker read each list's last keep rate as its gradient and skipped the regate lines on the stated ground that survival is not growth yield, but not the repair lines, so 35 of 81 lists presented a gradient of 1.00 that no growth measured and outranked every list whose last honest rate was 0.56 or 0.89; the tell is a returned number with almost no variance across cases, since a world would have scattered it; the changed move is the filter the picker applied to one author, applied to the other, which is the one string comparison that commit added; observed, and repaired within the hour, so the case is checkable only at that commit's parent. Not Green by construction, where the verdict is fixed; here the verdict can move and only the ceiling is the rule's.

Closed traverse: the reasoner walks a loop back to its own starting point and the environment returns the sum of its errors as the gap between where it stands and where it began; the carrier is the surveyor's traverse closing on the first station, the trial balance whose debits must meet its credits, the checksum, the quantity converted to another unit and back; what the environment adds is the one number the reasoner could not compute leg by leg, the accumulated error, with no indication of which leg carried it; the latency is the length of the loop and it can be re-asked by walking again; the degenerate closure is distributing the misclosure across the legs by rule and reporting the adjusted loop, which closes exactly by construction, so an exact closure reads as accuracy, and in the books the same closure is the compensating error, two mistakes that cancel and leave the balance sound; the tell is a closure that is exact rather than small; observed. Adds to Green by construction what a self-consistency check needs in order to carry information: two paths made independently, which the traverse's legs are and the test derived from the code is not.

Leading question: the reasoner asks the user in a form that contains its own proposal, so the reply returns a signature on the reasoner's output and not the thing the user knew; the carrier is the yes-or-no question, the shall-I-proceed, the draft presented for approval; what the environment could have added, intent, is exactly what the form excluded, and what it adds instead is authority; the latency is hours and it can be re-asked at a cost that rises with each ask, since the asker spends the user's patience; the degenerate closure is the ok read as an instruction, and its formal twin is the rule that questions are not instructions, which exists because the closure is common; the tell is a reply shorter than the question; the changed move is to ask for what the user knows and the reasoner does not, the constraint, the preference, the fact, rather than for a signature; analytical, with the doctrine observed. Not Once, where the reader was chosen for having no stake; here the reader is the one whose stake the reasoner needed and the form threw it away.

Laundered echo: the reasoner's output leaves through one channel and returns through another with its origin stripped, so it reads as independent corroboration; the carrier is a claim placed in an encyclopedia, printed by a newspaper that read it there, and then cited by the encyclopedia to the newspaper; one defector's report reaching an analyst through three liaison services as three reports; a summary an agent wrote, quoted by a colleague, read back by the agent as the colleague's finding; a fleet's maps read by the next fleet's author as the shape of the subject rather than the shape of the fleet; what the environment adds is a second signature and a delay, and what it strips is the first signature; the latency is days to years and each re-ask multiplies the copies; the degenerate closure is the mechanism itself; the tell is that the corroborating source's wording matches the reasoner's own, and that the count of independent sources falls to one when traced; observed in circular reporting and in citation loops, and speculative for the fleet case, which this map cannot measure from inside. Not enumeration-stalls' Two nets, one boat, where two enumerators miss the same members for the same reason; here one enumerator's members return as a second enumerator's.

Own footprint: the reasoner's act moves the quantity it reads, so the return is the world plus the reasoner's own pressure, inseparably; the carrier is the price after the order, the poll after the campaign, the metric after the announcement, the queue after the poll of it; what the environment adds is everyone else's acts, mixed with the reasoner's in a proportion it does not know; the latency runs from milliseconds to days and it can be re-asked, but every ask is an act that moves it again; the degenerate closure is reading the move the reasoner caused as information about what it was measuring, the momentum that was its own order, the interest that was its own broadcast; the tell is the part of the move that reverses when the reasoner stops, which was the reasoner's own, while the part that stays is the world's or the information the act leaked, and the two cannot be told apart until the reasoner stops; observed, as the temporary and permanent components of market impact. Not Laundered echo, where the reasoner's output comes back under someone else's signature; here it comes back under none.

Shared ledger: the environment returns a record to which others also write, and the reasoner counts their lines as its own because the record does not say whose they are; the carrier is an append-only log with a shared name, a metric that several processes increment, a queue several workers drain; what the environment adds is others' output, unlabelled; the latency is zero and it can be re-asked; the degenerate closure is the reasoner reading others' work as its own spend, its own progress, or its own history, and the observed case is the climb's spend level, a decayed sum over the timestamps of every line in its ledger directory, where, in the ledgers as committed on 2026-09-13, 76 fieldwork lines and 38 repair lines written by the fieldwork and repair passes sit beside the machine's own and each counts as a breath the machine took; the tell is a rate of one's own activity that moves when one is idle; the changed move is a by-field read before the line is counted; observed by reading the code, not by watching it stall. The mirror of Laundered echo, where one's own output returns as others'; here others' returns as one's own, and a reasoner in both loops at once cannot tell which way it is being fooled.

Lagged gauge: the return arrives after the reasoner has already acted again, so it reads a state it has since changed and corrects a correction; the carrier is a dashboard that aggregates on a delay, a stock report a month behind the orders, the pipe between a shower's tap and its head; what the environment adds is the true state at a past instant; the latency is the mechanism, and it can be re-asked, always late by the same amount; the degenerate closure is chasing one's own previous correction, so that an oscillation with a period near twice the lag is read as the world's volatility; the tell is the period; observed, as the bullwhip in a supply chain and the overshoot of any controller fed a delayed measurement. Not Clock, since the clock is what makes the lag a number; without a clock read beside the gauge the lag is invisible and the oscillation has no cause.

Compiler's list: the reasoner's whole text returns as a list of its consequences under rules the reasoner holds only in part, at once and in seconds; the carrier is a compiler, a type checker, a linter, a proof assistant, a schema validator; what the environment adds is consequence at a distance, the change on line three that fails line four hundred, under rules the reasoner had not internalized and could not have run in its head over the whole; the latency is seconds, it can be re-asked without limit, and it is deterministic, so re-asking with nothing changed is pure echo; the degenerate closure is editing to the error's text rather than to its cause, the cast that silences the type error, the annotation that satisfies the checker, the suppression comment, so that the next return is the reasoner's own decision and compiles is read as correct; the tell is a fix that changed the annotation and not the value; observed. Adds to denominator-manufactures' Compiler's catalogue, which takes the error list as a universe to count against, the loop's question: whether the list still comes from the rules or from the reasoner's edit of what the rules are shown.

Ping: the reasoner emits solely to get a return, and the environment adds range and shape by what it does to the emission; the carrier is sonar, radar, a health-check request, a canary release, an order for one share, a trial balloon; what the environment adds is time of flight, attenuation, and what bounced, none of which the reasoner could know before emitting; the latency is the distance and it can be re-asked at will; the degenerate closure is reverberation, reading the multipath echoes of one's own ping as targets and the wall one is standing beside as an object in the field; the tell is a return whose range does not change as the reasoner moves, the hull, the wall it carries with it, or one that sits at a whole multiple of a known reflector's range; observed. Not Own footprint, where the act was for its own sake and moved the world; here the act is the question, and the reasoner would not have emitted if it did not want the answer.

Pull, not push: the environment changes without telling the reasoner and returns its state only when asked, so the reasoner is late by exactly as long as it went without asking; the carrier is a repository others push to, a shared file, a database, a mailbox with no notification; what the environment adds is what others did since the last ask; the latency is unbounded until the ask and seconds after it, and it can be re-asked freely; the degenerate closure is reading the last snapshot as the live state, the tree's status taken at the start of a session read as the tree now; the tell is that the answer the reasoner holds is older than its own last act on the thing; observed. Not Lagged gauge, where the environment is late; here the environment is current and the reasoner is late, so the cure is not a faster gauge but a habit of asking before acting.

Clock: the loop that always answers and never the same, in which the reasoner's act is stamped and the return is the elapsed time since, which no record of the reasoner's own can hold, since a reasoner does not feel its own duration; the carrier is the wall clock and the timestamps on the ledger; what the environment adds is elapsed time and the true order of events, which memory reorders; the latency is zero and it can be re-asked without limit, each answer different; the degenerate closure is computing now from one's own last stamp, so that the clock is read against the record instead of the record against the clock, and a paused reasoner resumes believing no time has passed; the tell is a clock that agrees with the record exactly; observed, as the session resumed after an hour that acts on a state it last saw before the hour. Not Pull, not push, where what changed is others' acts; here nothing may have changed but the time, and the time is enough to make the last read stale.

Once: a reader with no memory of the reasoner's reasoning returns a verdict on the text alone, and the ask spends the freshness, so the same question cannot be put again, since the second reader has seen the first verdict or the first reader is no longer fresh; the carrier is the fresh-context critic, the specimen consumed by a destructive test, the first user who will never again not know the product; what the environment adds is what the text says without what the author meant; the latency is minutes to hours; the degenerate closure has two forms, the seat's menu returning its attractor, as the 38 critiques across three fleets that all returned admit-with-repairs, which the author read as the map's grade, and the correction of that, a brief that tells the critic the fact so that the critic now avoids the attractor because told, which is a second echo wearing the first's cure; the tell of spent freshness is a verdict that cites the previous verdict; observed. Not Blinded return, where the reader is stripped of the author's expectation by design and can be re-run on a new arm; here the reader is stripped by never having had it, and there is no new arm.

Blinded return: the loop is built so that the return cannot carry the reasoner's expectation, since the reasoner is removed from the part of the environment that decides; the carrier is the double-blind trial, the judge who sees candidates without their proposer, the seriation whose order is measured by one process while its axis is named by another, the review with the author's name cut off; what the environment adds is the outcome independent of hope; what it costs is that the return cannot carry intent either, so a blinded judge can say whether the text holds and not whether the target was preserved; the latency is the trial's, months, and it cannot be re-asked on the same arm, since once the blind is broken the loop is closed for that specimen; the degenerate closure is unblinding by tell, the side effect that reveals the arm, the voice that reveals the author, so that the return quietly carries the expectation again; the tell is a blinded read that agrees with the unblinded one on cases where the arm was guessable; observed. Not Once, where the reader was never given the author's reasoning; here the reader may have everything but the one thing, and the mechanism is the subtraction, which can be repeated on a new arm.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: empty greps and wrong paths, shell expansion of a separator, casts that silence a type error, golden files, a keep rate with a fixed denominator, surveyors' misclosure and the compass rule, trial balances and compensating errors, market impact, circular reporting and citation loops, the bullwhip, dashboards on a delay, sonar reverberation, canary releases, a repository read at session start, a session resumed after an hour, yes-or-no questions to a user, a fresh-context critic's verdict menu, a shared climb ledger, double-blind trials and blind judging; drawn from this repo's climb, repair, and critic passes and their ledgers, and from surveying, bookkeeping, trading, intelligence analysis, encyclopedia editing, supply chains, process control, acoustics, release engineering, clinical trials, and the ordinary run of a reasoner working through a shell.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed cases, most of them readable in this repo's own ledgers and source, and in two cases in this map's own making. Kept over before's counts (35 of 38 repair breaths at 1.00, 35 of 81 lists whose last read rate is a repair line's) were computed from the ledgers as committed on 2026-09-13, and the working tree already held more; the picker's filter on regate lines and not repair lines was read from the climb's source as it stood before commit 809dd01, which added repair lines to the filter forty-five seconds after this map's second breath, so that case is past tense, checkable only at the commit's parent, and a map that names a defect in its own pipeline is repaired before it is admitted. Shared ledger's spend-level case is read from source, not observed as a stall. Laundered echo's fleet case is speculative and marked. Leading question is analytical, with the doctrine that questions are not instructions observed as an operator rule. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable critic review applied 2026-09-13
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a working reasoner sits in several of these loops at once, and a single tool result can be Answered a different question and Empty return in one string; the list makes no claim to cover every kind of loop.

The seriation is an itinerary of what the return is made of, not a ranking of latency, trust, or cost; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, the two passages, the loop, and the incompatibility they draw are interpretations.

The cases from this repo (the keep rate of the repair breath, the picker's filter, the spend level over a shared ledger directory, the 38 critic verdicts, the measure-and-name split in seriation) are read from ledgers and source as they stood on 2026-09-13 and may be repaired after this map is written, as the picker's filter was by commit 809dd01 before this map was admitted; the outside cases (circular reporting, citation loops, market impact, the compass rule, the bullwhip, double blinding) are simplified to one mechanism each.

Out by the declared type: a reasoner re-reading its own context with nothing outside it, since no environment adds anything; an input the reasoner's output did not cause, the user's fresh instruction, the alert nobody asked for, which is input and not return; and what one reasoner leaves for a successor that never shares its context, which is window-successions. In only where the reasoner's own act went out and something came back to the same reasoner.

Neighbouring maps in this fleet: enumeration-stalls holds the stall mistaken for exhaustion, whose twin here is Empty return, the void mistaken for a none; context-horizons holds what lies past the edge of the window, where Pull, not push holds what lies in the environment until asked; composition-yields holds what crossing between passes yields, where Once and Blinded return hold what the single return of a judge can and cannot carry; denominator-manufactures' Compiler's catalogue takes the error list as a universe, where Compiler's list takes it as a return that an edit can corrupt.

seriation.axis: What the return is made of, walked from a return that is nothing to a return from which the reasoner has been subtracted on purpose: nothing, own bytes, own words under the carrier's grammar, own verdict, own denominator, own error sum, a signature on own proposal, own claim under another's signature, own act mixed with others' in the price, others' lines counted as own, the world at a past instant, own text under foreign rules, the world's shape on own ping, others' acts on request, elapsed time, a verdict from a reader who cannot be asked twice, and the outcome with the reasoner blinded out.
seriation.note: An authored walk of what comes back, not a scale of latency or of trust. Empty return opens it because nothing comes back and the reasoner supplies the reading; Blinded return closes it because the reasoner has been subtracted from the return by design, and the last stop before it, Once, is the reader who was never given the reasoner in the first place. The first six stops return the reasoner to itself with the carrier's changes: its bytes, its words re-parsed, its verdict, its denominator, its error sum; Green by construction, Kept over before, Closed traverse is the consequential run, three self-consistency returns of which only the traverse's carries a number the reasoner could not have computed, because its legs were walked independently, and the edge from the traverse to the ratio says how the one becomes the other: a rule applied before the number is reported removes the spread the world would have supplied, so the passage is read in the missing spread and not in the exact closure. Leading question, Laundered echo, Own footprint, Shared ledger is the second run, the mixture: own proposal under the user's signature, own claim under a stranger's, own act mixed with the world's in a proportion unknown, and others' lines counted as own, so the walk passes from self mislabelled as other to other mislabelled as self, and a reasoner in both loops cannot tell which way it is being fooled. Lagged gauge is the hinge, the first return that is the world and not the reasoner, but the world at an instant the reasoner has already changed; Compiler's list, Ping, Pull, not push, and Clock are returns of the world under rules, by physics, on request, and by time. Once and Blinded return end the walk where the return is a judgment and the map's question becomes what was removed from the judge, everything or one thing, and whether the removal can be repeated.

relations.from: Kept over before: a pass that may only cut reports a ratio whose denominator the rule fixed, so the number reads as a measurement and is a restatement of the rule; the carrier is the ledger line's keep rate, kept over candidates, where the repair breath's candidates are set equal to the items before it because it may not add; what the environment adds is at most the cuts, so the ratio is bounded at one and cannot rise, and in the ledgers as committed on 2026-09-13, 35 of the 38 repair breaths sat at 1.00 and three at 0.94 from a single cut each; the latency is zero and re-asking returns the same number; the degenerate closure lies downstream and was live in the climb's target picker until commit 809dd01, forty-five seconds after this map's second breath: the picker read each list's last keep rate as its gradient and skipped the regate lines on the stated ground that survival is not growth yield, but not the repair lines, so 35 of 81 lists presented a gradient of 1.00 that no growth measured and outranked every list whose last honest rate was 0.56 or 0.89; the tell is a returned number with almost no variance across cases, since a world would have scattered it; the changed move is the filter the picker applied to one author, applied to the other, which is the one string comparison that commit added; observed, and repaired within the hour, so the case is checkable only at that commit's parent. Not Green by construction, where the verdict is fixed; here the verdict can move and only the ceiling is the rule's.
relations.to: Shared ledger: the environment returns a record to which others also write, and the reasoner counts their lines as its own because the record does not say whose they are; the carrier is an append-only log with a shared name, a metric that several processes increment, a queue several workers drain; what the environment adds is others' output, unlabelled; the latency is zero and it can be re-asked; the degenerate closure is the reasoner reading others' work as its own spend, its own progress, or its own history, and the observed case is the climb's spend level, a decayed sum over the timestamps of every line in its ledger directory, where, in the ledgers as committed on 2026-09-13, 76 fieldwork lines and 38 repair lines written by the fieldwork and repair passes sit beside the machine's own and each counts as a breath the machine took; the tell is a rate of one's own activity that moves when one is idle; the changed move is a by-field read before the line is counted; observed by reading the code, not by watching it stall. The mirror of Laundered echo, where one's own output returns as others'; here others' returns as one's own, and a reasoner in both loops at once cannot tell which way it is being fooled.
relations.label: If a number fixed by one pass's rule is written into a ledger that a second loop reads as its own measurement, the rule crosses a level and becomes the second loop's world; the climb's picker did this until commit 809dd01 on 2026-09-13, ranking 35 repaired lists above every list whose last rate was measured because it read the by-field for regate lines and not for repair lines; a by-field read before the number is counted breaks the passage, and that break cost one string comparison, which is the whole of that commit.

relations.from: Once: a reader with no memory of the reasoner's reasoning returns a verdict on the text alone, and the ask spends the freshness, so the same question cannot be put again, since the second reader has seen the first verdict or the first reader is no longer fresh; the carrier is the fresh-context critic, the specimen consumed by a destructive test, the first user who will never again not know the product; what the environment adds is what the text says without what the author meant; the latency is minutes to hours; the degenerate closure has two forms, the seat's menu returning its attractor, as the 38 critiques across three fleets that all returned admit-with-repairs, which the author read as the map's grade, and the correction of that, a brief that tells the critic the fact so that the critic now avoids the attractor because told, which is a second echo wearing the first's cure; the tell of spent freshness is a verdict that cites the previous verdict; observed. Not Blinded return, where the reader is stripped of the author's expectation by design and can be re-run on a new arm; here the reader is stripped by never having had it, and there is no new arm.
relations.to: Laundered echo: the reasoner's output leaves through one channel and returns through another with its origin stripped, so it reads as independent corroboration; the carrier is a claim placed in an encyclopedia, printed by a newspaper that read it there, and then cited by the encyclopedia to the newspaper; one defector's report reaching an analyst through three liaison services as three reports; a summary an agent wrote, quoted by a colleague, read back by the agent as the colleague's finding; a fleet's maps read by the next fleet's author as the shape of the subject rather than the shape of the fleet; what the environment adds is a second signature and a delay, and what it strips is the first signature; the latency is days to years and each re-ask multiplies the copies; the degenerate closure is the mechanism itself; the tell is that the corroborating source's wording matches the reasoner's own, and that the count of independent sources falls to one when traced; observed in circular reporting and in citation loops, and speculative for the fleet case, which this map cannot measure from inside. Not enumeration-stalls' Two nets, one boat, where two enumerators miss the same members for the same reason; here one enumerator's members return as a second enumerator's.
relations.label: If the record given to the fresh reader carries the author's own verdict on it, a self-read in the gate, a ledger line saying what was accepted and why, then the fresh verdict returns the author's output through a second signature and the freshness that was the loop's only value is spent before the ask; a reader given the items and the of-sentence alone returns the text's verdict, and the tell is a critique whose strongest objection quotes the author's own gaps line.

relations.from: Lagged gauge: the return arrives after the reasoner has already acted again, so it reads a state it has since changed and corrects a correction; the carrier is a dashboard that aggregates on a delay, a stock report a month behind the orders, the pipe between a shower's tap and its head; what the environment adds is the true state at a past instant; the latency is the mechanism, and it can be re-asked, always late by the same amount; the degenerate closure is chasing one's own previous correction, so that an oscillation with a period near twice the lag is read as the world's volatility; the tell is the period; observed, as the bullwhip in a supply chain and the overshoot of any controller fed a delayed measurement. Not Clock, since the clock is what makes the lag a number; without a clock read beside the gauge the lag is invisible and the oscillation has no cause.
relations.to: Own footprint: the reasoner's act moves the quantity it reads, so the return is the world plus the reasoner's own pressure, inseparably; the carrier is the price after the order, the poll after the campaign, the metric after the announcement, the queue after the poll of it; what the environment adds is everyone else's acts, mixed with the reasoner's in a proportion it does not know; the latency runs from milliseconds to days and it can be re-asked, but every ask is an act that moves it again; the degenerate closure is reading the move the reasoner caused as information about what it was measuring, the momentum that was its own order, the interest that was its own broadcast; the tell is the part of the move that reverses when the reasoner stops, which was the reasoner's own, while the part that stays is the world's or the information the act leaked, and the two cannot be told apart until the reasoner stops; observed, as the temporary and permanent components of market impact. Not Laundered echo, where the reasoner's output comes back under someone else's signature; here it comes back under none.
relations.label: If the gauge lags and the reasoner's own acts are a large part of what it gauges, the return is the reasoner's previous act arriving late, so each correction reads as a fresh move of the world and the reasoner chases itself with a period set by the lag; where the reasoner's acts are small against the world's, the lag is only a delay and the loop between the two does not close, so a faster gauge shortens the chase but only a smaller hand or a longer wait opens the loop.

relations.from: Blinded return: the loop is built so that the return cannot carry the reasoner's expectation, since the reasoner is removed from the part of the environment that decides; the carrier is the double-blind trial, the judge who sees candidates without their proposer, the seriation whose order is measured by one process while its axis is named by another, the review with the author's name cut off; what the environment adds is the outcome independent of hope; what it costs is that the return cannot carry intent either, so a blinded judge can say whether the text holds and not whether the target was preserved; the latency is the trial's, months, and it cannot be re-asked on the same arm, since once the blind is broken the loop is closed for that specimen; the degenerate closure is unblinding by tell, the side effect that reveals the arm, the voice that reveals the author, so that the return quietly carries the expectation again; the tell is a blinded read that agrees with the unblinded one on cases where the arm was guessable; observed. Not Once, where the reader was never given the author's reasoning; here the reader may have everything but the one thing, and the mechanism is the subtraction, which can be repeated on a new arm.
relations.to: Leading question: the reasoner asks the user in a form that contains its own proposal, so the reply returns a signature on the reasoner's output and not the thing the user knew; the carrier is the yes-or-no question, the shall-I-proceed, the draft presented for approval; what the environment could have added, intent, is exactly what the form excluded, and what it adds instead is authority; the latency is hours and it can be re-asked at a cost that rises with each ask, since the asker spends the user's patience; the degenerate closure is the ok read as an instruction, and its formal twin is the rule that questions are not instructions, which exists because the closure is common; the tell is a reply shorter than the question; the changed move is to ask for what the user knows and the reasoner does not, the constraint, the preference, the fact, rather than for a signature; analytical, with the doctrine observed. Not Once, where the reader was chosen for having no stake; here the reader is the one whose stake the reasoner needed and the form threw it away.
relations.label: If the return is blinded so that it cannot carry the reasoner's expectation, it cannot carry the reasoner's intent either, so a blinded judge can rule on whether the text holds and not on whether the target was preserved; where the target must be judged, the judge must be told it, and what it is told is the author's output, so the two returns cannot be had from one reader, which is why the repair brief has the critic judge target preservation from an of-sentence the critic did not write, and why that judgment is closer to a Leading question than either seat intends.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does a reasoner's own output come back to it through something outside it, what does the outside add that the reasoner could not have known, how long does the return take and can it be asked for again, and when is the return only the reasoner's own output or rule wearing the look of evidence?
exploration.changed_question: What if what comes back is not the reasoner's own at all, or has had the reasoner taken out of it? Breath one took every loop as own output plus something added, and sorted by the addition. Pressing on Laundered echo, where own output returns as another's, showed the mirror the first framing could not hold: another's output returning as one's own, which the climb's spend level does by counting every line in a shared ledger directory as its own breath. Pressing on Clock, the return with nothing of the reasoner in it, showed that a return can be built to have the reasoner subtracted on purpose, the double blind and the blind judge, and that the subtraction costs intent as well as expectation, so a judge blinded to the author cannot say whether the author's target was kept. And the user's reply, which breath one had filed as the slowest carrier, turned out to be a return that can carry nothing but a signature if the question was shaped to get one. The question turned from what the environment adds to what the return is made of, and who labelled it.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing Kept over before and its edge to name commit 809dd01, which removed the picker defect forty-five seconds after breath two, moving the shell-expansion case from Read back from disk to Answered a different question, sharpening the tells of Own footprint and Ping, and repairing the Closed-traverse and Lagged-gauge edge labels; on the critic's modality notes the mode, form inference, near priority, and Shared ledger's counts were dated to the tree as committed on 2026-09-13.

neighbors.left: Green by construction: the reasoner writes both the artifact and the check that reads it, so the check returns the artifact's behaviour as its specification and passes on the day it is written by construction; the carrier is a test suite derived from the implementation, a golden file recorded from the current output, an acceptance criterion written after the work; what the environment adds is nothing today and persistence later, since the check will report when the behaviour changes, which is real information, so the loop is worth nothing on the first day and something on the ninetieth; the latency is seconds and it can be re-asked without limit; the degenerate closure is green read as correct; the tell is a check that has never been red and a failing case that nobody can name; the changed move is one case written from the requirement without looking at the code, run first; observed. Not Kept over before, where the verdict can still move and the denominator cannot; here the verdict itself was fixed when the check was derived.

Not Green by construction, where the verdict is fixed; here the verdict can move and only the ceiling is the rule's.
neighbors.separating_case: Two checks are run over the same map on the same afternoon. The first is a golden file recorded from the record as it stands, run again; it is green, and it will be green until the record changes, and on the day it is recorded it can tell nobody anything about the map. The second is the repair breath's keep rate over the same record; the repairer cuts one item that restated its neighbour and the rate reads 0.94. The number moved, so it is not Green by construction, and yet it could not have read 1.05, since the pass may not add, so its ceiling is the rule's and a downstream reader who sees 1.00 on 35 other maps is reading the ceiling. A reasoner who confuses them either trusts the ratio because it moved, or distrusts the golden file on the ninetieth day when it finally has something to say. The tell that separates them is whether the return can move at all, and in which direction: the verdict that cannot move is Green by construction, and the number that can move only down is Kept over before.

checks.boundary_case: The tempting nonmember is a reasoner re-reading its own earlier turns, its scratch notes still in the window, its own plan: nothing outside it adds anything, and the reading is memory, not return, so it is out by the declared type, and the moment the notes are written to disk and read back they are in as Read back from disk, since the carrier now adds the difference between what was meant and what was kept. The second tempting nonmember is an input the reasoner's output did not cause, the user's fresh instruction, an alert that fires on a schedule; it is input and it may be signal, but it is not the reasoner's act coming back, so it is out, and Clock sits on that fence and is in, since the return is elapsed time since the reasoner's own stamp and would not exist without the act. The third is the handoff to a successor that never shares the context, which is window-successions; the fence is whether the same reasoner reads what it wrote.
checks.form_inference: The map shows that a degenerate closure is a property of a route and not of a loop, since every one of its edges is a way of walking from an honest return into an echo by one edit, one report, or one hand-over. It shows a fork at Compiler's list, where the edit that changes the value keeps the return the rules' and the edit that changes what the checker is shown turns it into Green by construction while it still looks like the compiler's. It shows a passage of two levels, Closed traverse to Kept over before to Shared ledger, in which the only self-consistency return that carries a number the reasoner could not compute becomes, when the raw gap is adjusted away, a restatement of a rule, and that rule, once written into a ledger a second loop reads, becomes the second loop's measured world, as the climb's picker ranked 35 repaired maps by a number that no growth produced until commit 809dd01 closed the passage. It shows, on the one edge from Lagged gauge to Own footprint, a loop the world runs (act, gauge, act) and the graph does not draw, which closes only where the reasoner's own acts are large against the world's, and then gives the oscillation its period. It shows a passage at Once to Laundered echo, where a fresh reader handed the author's self-read returns the author's verdict under the reader's signature, so freshness is spent by what the reader is given and not by the ask. And it shows an incompatibility between Blinded return and Leading question: a return cannot be both blind to the reasoner's expectation and informed of the reasoner's intent, so the judge who is asked whether the target was preserved must be told the target, and what it is told is the author's output; the atlas's repair rule, which has the critic set target preservation from the of-sentence, sits exactly on this edge, and the map says the seat cannot be made clean, only honest about which side of the edge it stands on.
checks.target_preserved: Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-13) judged the target preserved, not a self-read: the item type holds for all seventeen, the neighbour pairs separate on a test a reader can run, no item is a tip, and the strange members (a void read as a none, a number that can move only down, a closure exact by construction, one's own order read as momentum, one's own claim read as corroboration, others' lines counted as one's own spend, a blinded judge that cannot rule on intent) stand as mechanisms and not as advice about verifying work; the critic's own finding was that the anchor case had gone stale in the tree by the map's own Pull, not push, and it now carries the commit it was observed at.
